chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Zurārah narrated from al-Ḥalabī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"Breastfeeding does not create a prohibition except that which is within two complete years."

key_terms.الرَّضَاعِ: breastfeeding or suckling that may establish kinship-related legal prohibition
key_terms.قَالَ: he said, introducing the transmitted statement of the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.يَحْرُمُ: becomes prohibited in a legal sense

ai.seo_question: When does breastfeeding create marriage prohibition in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning radaʿ (breastfeeding) and the resulting prohibition in marriage. It states that such prohibition is only established through breastfeeding that occurs within two complete years, marking the recognized legal period for this ruling.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4675 - Abdullah ibn Zurarah narrated from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:
"Breastfeeding does not create a prohibition except when it is for two complete years."
